class: digitization NORMALIZATION — the opposite direction from a digitization corruption. Corpus Corporum silently CORRECTED a defective form Migne printed, so without this patch our Latin column would print a word Migne did not print. First recorded instance of this class in the corpus; the second, found the same session, is data/tei-patches/8990.json.

patches.why: the plate prints 'Grande convivum' — no second i — read at 900 dpi on p. 375. Corpus Corporum normalized it to the standard 'convivium'. The defect is local to this lemma: Migne prints 'convivii' correctly at VERS. 5 two lines further on. Restoring his reading lets the English mark it [sic: *convivum*] as Pattern 12 requires.
